capabilities: Render a football lineup pitch from a lineup codeblock
Choose from nine predefined formations (433, 4231, 442, etc.)
Assign player names to positions ordered bottom-to-top, left-to-right
Display the lineup image in Preview mode
extras: Lineup images derive from Wikimedia Commons SVGs under CC-BY-SA-3.0, with attribution noted in the README; a TODO list lists unfinished ideas such as custom team colours and custom pitches.
problem: Obsidian has no way to render a football formation diagram from plain text in a note.

relations.evidence: This wouldn't have been possible without using THeK3nger's Chess Plugin as a reference.

summary: Codeblock renderer that draws football (soccer) lineups from a formation and a player list, visible in Preview mode.
